영문: 'Scuse me, nice Mr. Shopkeeper person...have you seen a hovering death machine?
No, nothing specifically of the hovering kind, no.
Oh! ....this was to be my greatest invention since Sideburns-In-A-Can, they make you handsome and lovely...
What are you talking about?

I call it the Hover Car TM*, so don't try to steal the name, it's TM'd. I installed the onboard computer, and it came alive and attacked my person. For the love of all that's glitin, you got to help me here!
OK, what on earth can I do?
Knock the fletchingety thing off the road before the authorities come and take me away again, imprisoned in kind ﻿to some pencil-necked geeks like myself, they-they stomp and they kick.
Great work, my Hindu friend!
Do not patronize my faith, OK?
Sorry, terribly sorry. Oh look, if you need a ride, instant message my cortex, by which I mean: "call me". Mwa-ha-hai-n!
The Legitimate Businessman's Social Club. Looks like Apu Nahasapeemapetilon is taking on...the Mob.

Oh-I have been selling tainted cola. Unless I redeem myself, I will be reincarnated as a sea cucumber; or worse, a land cucumber! I must find the source of this evil beverage. The soda in-voice commanded I go here but I see no cola factory. Ooh! A cola truck. Time for me to do that Hindu that I do!
Hello stereotypical Italians. Pleased to tell me the source of the evil cola?

We don't know nothin'...except that the vans are controlled by mysterious strangers. Anyway, you shouldn't stick your nose into other people's business. It could come back to haunt you...and your family.
Oh my gosh...your thinly-veiled threat has reminded me of my fatherly duties; I'm supposed to pick-up the octuplets at the doctor's!
I'm afraid we have a medical emergency!
Oh no, my babies!

Your babies are about to go to the bathroom all over my waiting room. And diapers aren't covered by your insurance. Ooh, you better hurry, I heard the parents of the Shelbyville 9 are grabbing every diaper in town.
I will get the diapers, but there's no way I could fit them in my car. Maybe Mr. Homer will have a large gas-guzzling American vehicle that I could use.
Borrowing? No! Selling to you at an insanely high price? Yes!
Quickly! Cover my incontinent children's tooshies!
That was close. Another minute and my office would look like the Ganges River.
Hello famous American clown. I wish to ask a favor.
Everyone wants to wet their beaks.
I require information about trucks delivering evil cola. How can I get this classified data?
Sorry Apu; I'm a drink-squeezy-punchy lowlife. You need a professional scumbag; follow a cop until you find one. You'll have better luck if ya, you know... look... American?
Thank you, horrible man.
My friend has the information in the DMV-go pick it up, pronto!
Oh thank you, thank you my violent associate!
Hand over your wallet, dude. This is totally a mugging.
What good luck, a criminal!
Huh?
Well surely a violent filth bag such as yourself, could find out who is driving the black cola vans.
Well, I do have a connection with the DMV; but it will cost you. You have to pick up the litter for my community service.
It is a deal.
Deal...now hand over your wallet.
Yes yes whatever.
Empty...I am the victim of chicanery most vile.
What possible service could this be to the community?
Shut up and take us back to the hideout, I mean-um, charity, place.
If you do not tell me who owns the cola trucks, then I will be forced to use...profanity!
Sir, the folder is empty! To rob me is one thing, but I never expected you to lie!
Dude, relax, OK? I've got the info you need. I just need help with a little more 'community service'. Ahaha; oh I'm totally evil!
I should know better than to trust a demented chuckle, but OK.
Oh Mr. Bart! I have discovered that the evil cola, is being made in the Springfield Museum!
But that closes in five minutes!
And my car is out of gas!
Just fill it up at the Kwik-E-Mart!
At those prices? No way!
Fine-we'll takemycar.
3, 2, 1, drive!
Hello little customer. Are you here to help me in some fashion?
Your nachos have hair in them!
The hair is your protein.
Well-OK. Well you have to race now.
Okay Apu, you've qualified for your license...big deal, you still work at a convenience store.
3...2...floor it loser!
You did better than the American drivers!
I AM AMERICAN!
Sure you are. That's great.
Hello little hoodlum, what is causing you to be standing here now?
I'm supervising a bonus race, doo-rag.
Six, twelve, one, go!
Hey aren't you the boy who nearly drowned in the nacho cheese?
I was in the newspaper!
You did pretty good out there. Is there a Miss Nahasapatta-whatever?
Oh, thank the Gods there is!
